blocks.text: Pichhli class mein aap ne parha ke jandar (organisms) khane ke molecules se energy kaise nikalte hain. Is ke liye jandar apne cells mein catabolic processes (bade molecules todne wale amal) karte hain jinhen mil kar cellular respiration kehte hain (glycolysis, Krebs cycle aur electron transport chain). In amal mein oxygen istemal hoti hai aur carbon dioxide banti hai. External respiration ka matlab hai jism ke level par mahol se oxygen lena aur carbon dioxide mahol mein nikalna. Is mein saans lena (breathing) aur capillaries mein oxygen aur carbon dioxide ka tabadla (exchange) shamil hai. Jo organs yeh kaam karte hain un se respiratory system banta hai. Is chapter mein insaan ka respiratory system aur saans ki aham beemariyan samjhai gayi hain.

blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)
blocks.text: Hamare cells oxygen khoon se lete hain. Khoon yeh oxygen phephdon (lungs) ki hawa se leta hai. Saans lene se lungs hawa se bhar jate hain aur oxygen lungs ki geeli jhilliyon (membranes) ke paar diffuse hoti (phail kar guzarti) hai.

Respiratory system un organs se bana hai jo jism ke level par external respiration karte hain (oxygen lena aur carbon dioxide nikalna). Is ke sab se aham organs lungs hain, jo gas ke is tabadle ke liye munasib respiratory surface dete hain.
Respiratory surface ki khoobiyan (properties)

Respiratory surface woh jagah hai jahan mahol aur khoon ke beech asal gas exchange hota hai. Yeh exchange diffusion se hota hai (gas zyada miqdar wali jagah se kam miqdar wali jagah ki taraf khud jati hai). Insaan aur hawa mein saans lene wale doosre vertebrates mein hawa ki oxygen khoon mein aur khoon ki carbon dioxide hawa mein diffuse hoti hai. Yeh khoobiyan respiratory surface par gas ka achha diffusion mumkin banati hain:

items: Yeh geeli (moist) aur permeable (guzarne dene wali) hai, taake gases is mein se guzar sakein.
Yeh patli hai, taake gases ko kam se kam fasla tay karna pade.
Is mein khoon ki supply hai, taake gases khoon mein aa aur ja sakein.
Is ko structural support (sahara) hai, taake yeh khuli rahe aur pichak (collapse) na jaye.
Yeh jism ke andar hai, taake is ki geeli satah ka pani hawa mein na ude.
Is par hawa aati jati hai (ventilation).
Hawa is tak shakhon wali naliyon se guzar kar pohanchti hai, taake pohanchne se pehle hawa mein poori nami (water vapour) aa jaye.

blocks.alt: Thaili (sac) jaisi tanaffusi satah jo oopar se khuli hai; do teer dikhate hain ke hawa us ki gardan se andar aur bahar jati hai. Is ki deewar ek cell moti hai aur andar nam (moist) tah hai, aur neeche khoon ki naliyon ki patti lipti hai. Khamdar teer dikhate hain ke carbon dioxide khoon se thaili mein aur oxygen thaili se khoon mein jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.1: Tanaffusi satah ki kuch khusoosiyat (textbook ki Figure 10.1 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Air moves in and out; Thin (one cell); Moist (with water & mucus); Blood supply; O2; CO2.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ke chaar labels list ki khoobiyon se milte hain: 'Air moves in and out' (hawa aati jati hai, ventilation), 'Thin (one cell)' (patli deewar, kam fasla), 'Moist' (nami mein gases ghul kar guzarti hain) aur 'Blood supply' (khoon O₂ le jata aur CO₂ lata hai).
Insaan ke respiratory system ke hisse

Respiratory system ke organs mil kar raston ka ek musalsal silsila banate hain jise respiratory tract kehte hain; isi se hawa jism mein aati aur bahar jati hai. Respiratory tract ke do bade hisse hain: upper respiratory tract (upar wala) aur lower respiratory tract (neeche wala).
Upper respiratory tract

Is mein nasal cavity (naak ki khali jagah), pharynx (gala) aur larynx (awaz ka dabba) shamil hain. Yeh organs hawa ko andar aur bahar le jate hain. Yeh andar aane wali hawa ko saaf, geela aur garam bhi karte hain. In organs mein gas exchange nahi hota.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki headings (aur Figure 10.2 ki caption) mein “Respiratory Track” chhapa hai. Sahi lafz respiratory tract (saans ka rasta) hai; kitab ka apna text bhi “tract” likhta hai.
1- Nasal cavity

Naak ke bahar ke surakh, nostrils (nathne), nasal cavity mein khulte hain. Yeh naak ke peeche hawa se bhari ek badi jagah hai jise nasal septum (nasal bone ka hissa) do hisson mein baant-ta hai. Jab saans ki hawa nasal cavity se guzarti hai to satah ke bilkul qareeb khoon ki naliyan use garam aur geela kar deti hain. Naak ke baal aur mucous membranes ka banaya hua mucus hawa ke bade zarron (particles) ko pakad lete hain taake woh aage na jayen. Saans ke kaam ke ilawa nasal cavity mein chemoreceptors bhi hain jo soonghne ke liye zaroori hain aur zaiqe (taste) mein bhi hissa lete hain.
2- Pharynx

Pharynx nali jaisi banawat hai jo nasal cavity aur oral cavity (munh) ko larynx aur oesophagus se jodti hai. Hawa aur khana dono is se guzarte hain, is liye yeh respiratory aur digestive dono systems ka hissa hai. Hawa nasal cavity se pharynx ke raste larynx tak jati hai (aur ulta bhi). Khana munh se pharynx ke raste oesophagus tak jata hai.
3- Larynx

Larynx pharynx ko trachea se jodta hai. Yeh muscles aur cartilages (narm haddi) ka bana hai. Ise voice box (awaz ka dabba) bhi kehte hain kyunke is mein do patti jaisi banawatein hain jinhen vocal cords kehte hain. Jab hawa in par se guzarti hai to vocal cords thartharate (vibrate karte) hain aur awaz paida hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Sar aur seene ka pehlu se manzar. Sar aur gardan mein nasal cavity, pharynx aur larynx ko upper respiratory tract ki bracket mein rakha gaya hai. Neeche cartilage ke halqon wali trachea do bronchi mein batti hai jo dono phephron ke andar shakhein banati hain; yeh lower respiratory tract hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.2: Tanaffusi rasta (respiratory tract) (textbook ki Figure 10.2 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Upper Respiratory Tract (Nasal cavity, Pharynx, Larynx); Lower Respiratory Tract (Trachea, Bronchus, Lung).

blocks.text: Epiglottis cartilage ka ek dhakkan (flap) hai jo larynx ke munh, glottis, ke aage aur upar hota hai. Jab hawa larynx mein jati hai to epiglottis upar khada rehta hai taake hawa ko rasta mile. Jab hum kuch nigalte hain to zaban ki peeche ki harkat larynx ko upar utha deti hai. Is se epiglottis neeche aa kar glottis ko band kar deta hai, aur nigla hua khana larynx mein nahi jata.

blocks.title: Vocal cords ki harkat
blocks.text: Larynx ki kuch muscles saans lene ke liye vocal cords ko door karti hain. Doosri muscles awaz nikalne ke liye vocal cords ko qareeb lati hain. Yahi doosri muscles awaz ki pitch (bareek ya moti awaz) aur volume (oonchi ya halki awaz) ko bhi control karti hain.

blocks.alt: Baen, bahar se manzar: larynx, cartilage ki dhaal jis ke oopar epiglottis ka sira hai, trachea ke oopar hai; trachea C shakal ke cartilage halqon ki tube hai. Daen, oopar se manzar: aage epiglottis, trachea ke gehre surakh ke gird V bana ti halki vocal cords, aur un ke gird cartilage ka halqa.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.3: Larynx aur trachea (textbook ki Figure 10.3 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Larynx, Trachea, External view; Epiglottis, Vocal cords, Trachea, Cartilage, View from top.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se dekhne par vocal cords V ki shakal mein hain; in ke beech ki khuli jagah (glottis) se hawa trachea mein jati hai. Nigalte waqt epiglottis is surakh ko dhak leta hai.

blocks.title: Khansi ka reflex
blocks.text: Agar nigla hua khana larynx mein jane lage to larynx mein khaarish hoti hai aur zor ki khansi (cough reflex) aati hai. Aam tor par yeh khansi us cheez ko larynx se nikal kar gale mein wapas phenk deti hai.
Lower respiratory tract

Trachea aur lower respiratory tract ke baqi raste hawa ko upper tract aur lungs ke beech le jate hain. Yeh raste baar baar shakhon mein bat kar ek darakht (tree) jaisi shakal banate hain. Insaan ke respiratory tract mein hairat angez tor par 2,414 kilometre lambe hawa ke raste hain! Magar gas exchange sirf lungs mein hota hai.

blocks.alt: Trachea dono phephron ke beech neeche aa kar do bronchi mein batti hai, jo daen aur baen phephre ke andar baar baar shakhein banati hain, jaise ulta darakht.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.4: Lower respiratory tract ki darakht jaisi shakhein (textbook ki Figure 10.4 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Trachea, Right lung, Left lung.

blocks.text: 1- Trachea

Trachea (windpipe, saans ki nali) larynx ko lungs se jodti hai aur hawa ko guzarne deti hai. Yeh respiratory tract ka sab se chauda rasta hai: taqreeban 1 inch chaudi aur 4–6 inch lambi. Is ki deewaron mein smooth muscles aur C ki shakal ke cartilage ke chhalle hote hain. Trachea ke andar mucus aur cilia (baal jaise ubhaar) hote hain. Cilia mucus mein phanse zarron ko pharynx ki taraf dhakelte hain. C shakal ka cartilage trachea ko mazbooti aur sahara deta hai taake rasta khula rahe. Neeche ja kar trachea do bronchi mein bat jati hai.
2- Bronchi, bronchioles aur alveoli

Do primary bronchi hain (wahid: bronchus). Right aur left bronchi lungs mein dakhil ho kar chhoti secondary bronchi mein bat jati hain. Left lung mein do aur right lung mein teen secondary bronchi hain. Secondary bronchi mein C shakal ke cartilage ki jagah cartilage plates hoti hain. Secondary bronchi aur chhoti tertiary bronchi mein, aur woh bohat chhoti bronchioles mein bat jati hain. Bronchioles mein cartilage plates nahi hoti. Yeh kai baar bat kar terminal bronchioles banati hain. Terminal bronchioles alveolar ducts mein khatam hoti hain, aur alveolar ducts lungs mein hawa ki nanhi thailiyon (air sacs) ke guchhon par khatam hoti hain; in thailiyon ko alveoli (wahid: alveolus) kehte hain.
3- Lungs (phephde)

Lungs respiratory tract ke sab se bade organs hain. Har lung bahar se do jhilliyon (membranes) mein lipta hai. Pehli jhilli, visceral pleura, lung par chadhi hoti hai, aur doosri, parietal pleura, seene ki khali jagah (thoracic cavity) ki andar ki deewar par. In dono ke beech ki chhoti si jagah, pleural cavity, fluid (maye) se bhari hoti hai. Yeh fluid saans lete waqt lungs ko aasani se phailne aur sukadne deta hai. Har lung lobes (hisson) mein bata hai. Right lung bada hai aur is ke teen lobes hain. Left lung chhota hai aur is ke do lobes hain. Chhote left lung ki wajah se dil ke liye jagah banti hai, jo seene ke beech se thoda left par hai.

blocks.alt: Trachea primary bronchi mein batti hai, jo phephron ke andar secondary aur tertiary bronchi banati hain. Daen phephre (tasveer mein baen taraf) ke superior, middle aur inferior lobes hain; chhota baen phephra superior aur inferior lobes rakhta hai aur us ke neeche andar ke kinare par cardiac notch hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.5: Daen aur baen phephre (textbook ki Figure 10.5 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Trachea, Primary bronchus, Secondary bronchus, Tertiary bronchus, Superior lobe, Middle lobe, Inferior lobe, Cardiac notch, Right lung, Left lung.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Left lung chhota hai aur is mein cardiac notch (dil ke liye khali jagah) hai, is liye is ke sirf do lobes hain. Har lobe ko ek secondary bronchus milti hai: right mein teen, left mein do.

Jaisa pehle bataya, terminal bronchi (bronchioles) alveolar ducts mein khatam hoti hain. Har alveolar duct alveoli ke ek guchhe mein khulti hai. Yahi guchhe lung ka zyada tar hissa banate hain aur in ke gird khoon ki capillaries hoti hain. Har guchhe mein 20-30 alveoli hote hain. Alveolus geeli epithelial tissue ka bana hota hai (sirf 0.1 micrometre mota). Is liye alveoli woh respiratory surface hain jahan hawa aur khoon ke beech gas exchange hota hai.

blocks.title: Surfactant
blocks.text: Alveoli ke kuch epithelial cells surfactant naam ka liquid banate hain jo alveoli ke andar ki satah par phaila hota hai. Hawa nikalte waqt yeh alveoli ko pichakne aur aapas mein chipakne se bachata hai. Sehatmand lungs mein surfactant musalsal banta aur wapas jazb hota rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Terminal bronchiole alveolar duct mein jati hai jo gol alveoli ke do guchhon (sacs) mein khulti hai. Ek guchhe ki bahari satah par capillaries ka jaal hai jo neele se surkh hota jata hai. Neeli pulmonary artery aur surkh pulmonary vein hawa ke raste ke saath chalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.6: Alveoli ke guchhe (textbook ki Figure 10.6 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Cluster/Sac of alveoli, Capillaries, Alveolar duct, Terminal bronchiole, Pulmonary artery, Pulmonary vein, Alveolus.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pulmonary artery mein khoon deoxygenated (neela dikhaya gaya) hai aur pulmonary vein mein oxygenated (surkh). Capillaries alveoli ke andar nahi, bahar lipti hain; gas patli deewar ke aar paar diffuse hoti hai.

blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)
blocks.text: Aap parh chuke hain ke pulmonary arteries deoxygenated (oxygen ke baghair) khoon lungs tak lati hain. Yeh khoon lungs mein oxygen leta hai aur pulmonary veins oxygen wala khoon wapas dil tak lati hain, jahan se dil use poore jism mein pump karta hai. Lungs ko dil se oxygen wala khoon bhi milta hai jo lungs ke apne cells ko cellular respiration ke liye oxygen deta hai.

Alveoli lungs ki functional units (kaam karne wali ikaiyan) hain jahan gas exchange hota hai. Dono lungs mein 700 million tak alveoli ho sakte hain. Yeh gas exchange ke liye bohat badi kul surface area dete hain. Saans andar lene par alveoli hawa se bhar jate hain aur lungs phail jate hain. Alveoli ki hawa ki oxygen diffusion se un capillaries ke khoon mein chali jati hai jo alveoli ko ghere hue hain. In capillaries ka khoon carbon dioxide (yeh bhi diffusion se) alveoli ki hawa mein chhod deta hai. Saans bahar nikalne par hawa alveoli se nikal kar bahar chali jati hai aur carbon dioxide saath le jati hai.
Breathing ya ventilation ka mechanism (saans kaise chalta hai)

Hawa ka jism mein andar aana aur bahar jana breathing ya ventilation kehlata hai. Hamare lungs khud hawa nahi kheenchte ya bahar nahi dhakelte. Yeh kaam lungs mein kam (negative) aur zyada (positive) pressure bana kar hota hai, aur yeh kaam muscles ke do set karte hain: (i) diaphragm (gumbad jaisi badi skeletal muscle jo seene ki khali jagah ko pait se alag karti hai) aur (ii) intercostal muscles (har do pasliyon ke beech wali muscles).

blocks.title: Oonchai par saans
blocks.text: Oonchi jagahon par hawa ka pressure (atmospheric pressure) kam hota hai. Is liye lungs ka pressure bahar se kam karne ke liye seene ko zyada phailana padta hai; isi liye oonchai par saans lena mushkil hota hai. Jism in halaat mein oxygen behtar lene ke tareeqe apna leta hai; isi liye khiladi aksar muqable se pehle oonchai par training karte hain.

Inspiration (saans andar lena): hawa andar lene ko inspiration ya inhalation kehte hain. Is ke liye diaphragm sukadta (contract hota) hai, neeche aata hai aur zyada chapta ho jata hai. Usi waqt intercostal muscles bhi sukadti hain, pasliyon ko upar uthati hain aur rib cage (pasliyon ka pinjra) phail jata hai. Is se seene mein jagah barh jati hai. Visceral aur parietal pleura aapas mein chipki hoti hain, is liye seena phailne se lungs bhi phail jate hain. Lungs phailne se un ke andar hawa ka pressure kam ho jata hai. Jab lungs ka pressure bahar ki hawa ke pressure se kam ho jata hai to hawa lungs mein aa jati hai.

Expiration (saans bahar nikalna): hawa bahar nikalne ko expiration ya exhalation kehte hain. Inspiration mein seena aur lungs phail kar khinche hue (elastic tension mein) hote hain. Intercostal muscles aur diaphragm dheele (relax) hote hain to yeh khinchao khatam ho jata hai. Diaphragm dheela ho kar phir gumbad jaisa ho jata hai. Intercostal muscles dheeli hone se pasliyan neeche aati hain aur rib cage andar ko aata hai. Is se seene ki jagah kam hoti hai aur lungs wapas sikud jate hain. Ab lungs ka pressure bahar ki hawa se zyada ho jata hai aur hawa lungs se bahar nikal jati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek parinde ka pehlu se manzar do dafa. Har ek mein trachea seene ke andar phephron tak jati hai; phephron ke aage anterior air sacs aur peeche posterior air sacs hain. Inhalation mein air sacs bhare (bare) hain aur exhalation mein sukre (chhote).
blocks.caption: Parinde ke air sacs aur phephre (textbook ke 'High altitudes and birds' box ki drawing ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Anterior air sacs, Posterior air sacs, Lungs, Inhalation, Exhalation.

blocks.title: Parindon (birds) mein saans
blocks.text: Parindon ke jism mein lungs ke saath air sacs (hawa ki thailiyan) bhi hoti hain. Hawa ek hi simt (direction) mein chalti hai: bahar se posterior (pichhli) air sacs mein, wahan se lungs mein, phir anterior (agli) air sacs mein aur phir bahar. Hawa khoon ke bahao ki ulti simt mein chalti hai, is liye gas exchange bohat achha hota hai. Isi tarah ki saans se parinde oonchai par bhi, jahan oxygen kam hoti hai, zaroorat ki oxygen le lete hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Parinde mein hawa ek hi rukh mein chalti hai: bahar se posterior air sacs, phir lungs, phir anterior air sacs aur bahar. Inhalation mein dono air sacs bharte hain, exhalation mein khali hote hain; lungs mein hawa dono waqt aage barhti rehti hai, is liye gas exchange zyada hota hai.

blocks.alt: Seene ke do saamne ke manzar. Inspiration (inhalation): hawa trachea se andar aati hai; surkh teer pasliyon ke pinjre ko bahar aur chapte diaphragm ko neeche jata dikhate hain, aur phephre bare hain. Expiration (exhalation): hawa bahar jati hai; teer pinjre ko andar aur gumbad bane diaphragm ko oopar jata dikhate hain, aur phephre chhote hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.7: Saans lene ka mechanism (textbook ki Figure 10.7 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Air moves in; Intercostal muscles contract and rib cage expands; Lung; Diaphragm; Diaphragm contracts (moves down); Inspiration (Inhalation); Air moves out; Intercostal muscles relax and rib cage becomes smaller; Diaphragm relaxes (moves up); Expiration (Exhalation).

blocks.text: Saans ka control

Har saans medulla oblongata (brain stem ka ek hissa) mein maujood respiratory centre ke neurons shuru karte hain. Yeh neurons diaphragm aur intercostal muscles ko signals (impulses) bhejte hain, woh sukadti hain aur inspiration hoti hai. Jab yeh neurons signals bhejna band karte hain to diaphragm aur intercostal muscles dheele ho jate hain aur expiration hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Samjhayein: jo shakhs diaphragm nahi hila sakta woh phir bhi saans kyun le sakta hai, magar kam gehri? Aur agar pleural cavity mein surakh ho jaye to lung kyun nahi phailta?
blocks.explanation: Intercostal muscles phir bhi pasliyan utha kar seena bada kar sakti hain; is se lungs ka pressure itna kam ho jata hai ke kuch hawa andar aa jaye. Magar diaphragm ke neeche aaye baghair seene ki jagah thodi hi barhti hai, is liye har saans kam gehri hoti hai. Lungs sirf is liye phailte hain ke visceral aur parietal pleura pleural fluid ki wajah se aapas mein chipki hoti hain. Agar pleural cavity mein hawa aa jaye to yeh chipkan khatam ho jati hai aur lung seene ki deewar ke saath nahi phailta.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: External respiration: jism ke level par O₂ lena aur CO₂ nikalna. Respiratory surface geeli, permeable, patli, khoon wali, sahare wali, jism ke andar, hawa se ventilated aur shakhon wali naliyon ke baad hoti hai.

Upper tract (nasal cavity, pharynx, larynx jis mein vocal cords aur epiglottis) hawa ko tayyar karta hai; lower tract (C shakal cartilage wali trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, alveolar ducts) hawa ko alveoli tak le jata hai. Gas exchange sirf lungs mein hota hai; right lung 3 lobes, left 2; dono pleura mein lipte.
Alveoli: 20-30 ke guchhe, 0.1 micrometre deewar, 700 million tak, gird capillaries, andar surfactant.

Saans: diaphragm aur intercostal muscles sukadti hain, seena phailta hai, pressure kam hota hai, hawa andar aati hai; muscles dheeli hoti hain, lungs sikudte hain, pressure barhta hai, hawa bahar jati hai. Medulla oblongata ka respiratory centre ise chalata hai.
